bio: Young Smugglaz is a Toronto-area hip-hop artist connected to the Jane and Finch rap scene. The artist appears on the 2024 project 'Jane & Finch Most Wanted, Vol. 1,' including 'Sam Taylor' with Young Don Million and 'RIP JR. D.' Northern Dial carries Young Smugglaz as part of its Jane and Finch and Toronto hip-hop catalogue.

Toronto rapper Young Stitch is a Canadian freestyle specialist and independent hip-hop artist known for winning BET Freestyle Friday's world championship and for his work with Stealth Bomb Records and Lunch Room Poetz.
Vancouver indie-rock band Yukon Blonde makes harmony-rich guitar pop and rock that has expanded over time into synth-heavy, psychedelic and dance-oriented songwriting.
Montréal-based singer-songwriter and multi-instrumentalist Yves Jarvis makes genre-bending experimental music that moves through indie rock, R&B, folk, soul and home-recorded abstraction.

Rouyn-Noranda-born, Montréal-rooted singer, rapper and songwriter Zach Zoya blends melodic rap, alternative R&B and pop with a cross-cultural perspective shaped by South African and French-Canadian influences.

Zargo, also known as Rockboy Zargo and King Jzargo, is a Toronto hip-hop artist active in the city's independent rap scene. His releases and visuals have been covered as part of Toronto's contemporary street and melodic rap movement. Northern Dial carries Zargo as part of its Toronto hip-hop catalogue.
Zayo is a Québec rapper whose French-language catalogue sits within contemporary rap québécois, pairing direct street-rap writing with melodic modern production.

Toronto electronic duo Zeds Dead, formed by Dylan Mamid and Zachary Rapp-Rovan, has built an international bass-music career around dubstep, drum and bass, house, hip-hop sampling and the Deadbeats label.
Montréal-raised singer-songwriter Zeina blends contemporary R&B and pop with Arabic musical influence, writing and performing across English, French and Arabic.
Toronto independent band ZIG MENTALITY makes immersive, self-produced rock built around a studio-focused approach and a tightly controlled DIY aesthetic.

Zinera is a Montreal rapper from Anjou whose music sits within Quebec's contemporary francophone hip-hop scene. His releases have gained attention through streaming and local rap media, reflecting the city's current independent street-rap movement. Northern Dial carries Zinera as part of its Montreal hip-hop catalogue.
Québec musician, singer-songwriter and actor Édouard Tremblay-Grenier makes French-language alternative pop and rock rooted in the province's contemporary songwriting tradition.
